notes.title: Enemy Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed visual bugs in some normal mobs.
[*] Fixed bug with the shovel-wielding vampire (Evangeline Castle) that prevented the player from jumping.
[*] Adjusted the attack collision area of the mace-wielding executioner enemy (Balthazar Castle).
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved performance for all normal mobs.
[*] Fixed bug with dead mob bodies.
[*] Visual adjustments to the Balthazar Castle scenario.
[*] Removed optional rooms at the entrance of Balthazar Castle.
[/list]

notes.title: Leonard Castle Illumination Correction + Boss Battles Optimized Performance
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed the illumination of Leonard Castle, which was abnormally bright.
[*] Optimized the performance of the boss battles against Leonard, Evangeline, and Selenite.
[/list]

notes.title: Urgent Evangeline Fix + Mobs Performance
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where the Evangeline battle would not start.
[*] All minibosses, Balthazar, and Draculara have been optimized for performance.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Visual Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed numerous lighting bugs on various objects ant tiles.
[/list]

notes.title: Some Adjustments
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Marcos (Leonard Castle miniboss) health reduced from 400 to 250, colliders remade.
[*] Fixed bug with health station and energy station interactions.
[*] Kitsune tails layer and synchronization corrected.
[*] Adjusted some health station spawn coordinates.
[*] Performance optimization: adjusted offset for room deletions.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] HP stations now guaranteed after miniboss battles.
[*] Elysia's light beam damage reduced by 50% (no longer instant-kills bosses, still instant-kills normal mobs).
[*] Jacoh (axe-wielding wolf) damage reduced.
[*] Removed bouncing death prefabs.
[*] Geisha bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Fixes and Shoot Damage Buff
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added camera height collider at stage entrances.
[*] Boss cards fixed.
[*] Shoot damage buff (min damage from 15 to 25, max damage from 30 to 50).
[*] Balthazar buff consumes energy (temporarily consumes the entire energy bar).
[*] Fixed bug where stations would lose money.
[/list]

notes.title: Urgent Bug Fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Previously, Cassandra’s safe zone from Evangeline’s Castle was appearing in Draculara’s Castle, causing her shop to not function.
[/list]

notes.title: Drink Machines Correction and Small Updates
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Upgrade and drink vending machines now work "correctly" (still being polished) at a cost of 50 coins.
[*] 
[*] When the controller disconnects during a match, the game now pauses automatically.
[*] 
[*] Fixed lighting issues at some stations.
[/list]

notes.title: Main Menu updates V0.1.176 EA
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Further menu navigation improvements.
[*] The settings bug in the main menu, which occurred after returning from a match, has been fixed.
[*] The settings panel in the pause menu is temporarily disabled while we work on fixing it.
[/list]

notes.title: UI navigation improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Menu UI navigation is now smoother and more dynamic.
[*] We are working on fixing bugs in the settings and pause menus.
[/list]

notes.title: Urgent Selenite Bug Fix V0.1.174
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed the recent bug where the Selenite battle would not start.
[/list]

notes.title: Buff Cards Font Bug FIx
notes.content: Fixed the issue where the upgrade card fonts were bugged in CN, KR, and JP languages.

notes.title: Shoot adjustment + buff V0.1.172
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Now you can properly jump right after shooting.
[*] Shoot minimal damage buffed from 10 to 15.
[*] Shoot max damage buffed from 20 to 30.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Updates V0.1.171
notes.content: [list][*][p]Trams now appearing at the entrance of castles (Decoration).[/p][/*][*][p]Selenite infinity sound bug fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Evangeline, Leonard, and Draculara Castle safe zones updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Balthazar Castle loading scene fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Draculara room right wall collider properly implemented.[/p][/*][*][p]Selenite entrance ground tiles fixed.[/p][/*][/list]
